p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e3f5e007.py'; code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full-width rows and full-height columns are the colored dividers.
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Keep only dividers whose color is not the dominant background color.
    from collections import Counter
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_cuts = [r for r in row_cuts if grid[r][0] != bg]
    col_cuts = [c for c in col_cuts if grid[0][c] != bg]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(bounds[i]+1, bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    rs, cs = spans(h, row_cuts), spans(w, col_cuts)
    blocks = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in rs for c0,c1 in cs]
    # The block with the most non-background cells is the pattern to repeat.
    def score(b):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=b
        return sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
    src = max(blocks, key=score)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=src
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b in blocks:
        ar,br,ac,bc=a,b
        if br-ar != r1-r0 or bc-ac != c1-c0:
            continue
        for i in range(r1-r0):
            for j in range(c1-c0):
                out[ar+i][ac+j]=grid[r0+i][c0+j]
    return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(code); print(p)
